titleLine2: The same journal, in your pocket
lead: The official GameTrace APK — sessions, library, and stats just like in the browser. You create your account through Discord.
unavailable: The APK file is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or use the browser version.

handoff.ariaLabel: Send the link to your phone
handoff.title: SEND TO PHONE
handoff.hint: Scanning opens this page on your phone — then tap Download APK.

step1.title: Download the file
step1.body: Tap Download APK and save the file on your phone.

step2.title: Open gametrace.apk
step2.body: Find the file in your notifications or file manager and open it.

step3.title: Allow the installation
step3.body: If prompted, allow installs from this browser or from unknown sources.
